author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
At the Academy Museum's Debbie Reynolds Conservation Studio, Adam gets up close with a surviving spacesuit helmet from 2001: A Space Odyssey Spacesuit! Academy Museum conservators explain the process of preserving this iconic piece of film costuming and the surprising details learned from analyzing its original paint job. 

Learn more about the Academy Museum and its collection at https://www.academymuseum.org/
